normalConvention: OpenGL tangent space, +Y; linear data; normalized after filtering
uvConvention: Atlas rects are integer top-left pixel x,y,width,height; uv is top-origin u0,v0,u1,v1. Convert v for bottom-origin consumers.

materials.desc: Warm pale-gold sand, fine grains, tiny shell fragments, mineral flecks and subtle wind ripples.
Darker wet tan sand, faint sheen, bubble holes and small worm casts.
Pale grey-gold lagoon sand with parallel ripple ridges and a few shell fragments.
Rounded dark stones in sand, green algae film and barnacles.
Grey-brown granite breakwater boulders with salt crust and barnacle patches.
Pale poured concrete, formwork lines, salt staining and restrained rust streaks.
Six by six 40 cm sand-coloured pavers; sand in thin joints and a few cracks.
Silver-grey weathered hardwood pier planks, dark nail heads and salt bleaching.
Creosoted vertical wood grain with green slime and barnacles at the base; horizontal repeat only.
Twisted tan hemp fibres; repeats along its vertical length.
Overlapping dry golden and silver palm fronds.
Neutral white and grey vertical canvas bands with cotton weave; tintable.
Scuffed fibreglass, white above cobalt blue below a thin red waterline; horizontal repeat preserves the waterline.

effects.desc: Soft overlapping ripple normal map, original generated normals normalized to +Z hemisphere.
White sea-foam lace with genuine transparent open-water holes.
Soft white caustic cell lines on black, linear mask.

atlases.desc: Six numbered windsurf sails with windows; six original striped kite wings.
Eight original board-deck designs, pads and bold graphics without brands.
Twelve striped or printed towels and four canvas bag tops.
Original Spanish hand-painted signs on weathered wooden boards.
Cream/red hand-painted names on transparent decals, spelling preserved verbatim.
Right-facing gull: four flap frames, standing, two walking frames and cleaning.
Silver jack, yellow-striped grunt and blue tang, two tail poses each.
Pale ghost crab top-down, conch and scallop; fourth cell intentionally unused.
Three upright cutout cards; fourth cell intentionally unused.
